causes.text: On July 6, 2022, Amazon announced a partnership with Just Eat Takeaway's Grubhub that gave Amazon a right to acquire a 2% stake in Grubhub and allowed U.S. Prime members to access Grubhub+ without additional fees. The agreement marked Amazon's re-entry into meal delivery and intensified competition in the sector.

source_info.title: Amazon makes Grubhub deal to give Prime members fee-free food

effects.text: Shares of DoorDash fell about 7% following Amazon's announcement, as investors worried that Amazon's entry into restaurant delivery would siphon demand from DoorDash.

source_info.title: Amazon Prime adding free Grubhub delivery for members sends DoorDash shares down

causal_reasoning_chain.description: Amazon's partnership gave Prime members free access to Grubhub+, effectively lowering the cost of ordering delivery through Grubhub and bringing Amazon's large membership base into meal delivery.

Investors anticipated that Amazon's scale and loyalty program could rapidly boost Grubhub volumes and pressure DoorDash's share and pricing power, so expectations for DoorDash's growth were revised down.
Upon the announcement, DoorDash's stock fell roughly 7%, reflecting immediate concern about heightened competition and potential demand diversion.

rationale: Amazon's re-entry via Grubhub introduced a well-capitalized competitor able to bundle delivery perks with Prime, threatening DoorDash's customer base and prompting a same-day markdown in DoorDash shares.
counterfactual_analysis: Absent the Amazon-Grubhub partnership, investors would have perceived less near-term competitive threat to DoorDash, and the stock likely would have been more stable on the day.

adversarial_confounders.text: Overall market volatility and macro concerns about inflation hitting discretionary demand.
adversarial_confounders.impact: Broader risk-off moves may have contributed to DoorDash's decline independent of Amazon's news.

details.commentary: By bundling Grubhub+ into Prime, Amazon gave its members a compelling alternative to ordering through DoorDash. The added convenience and perceived savings lowered switching costs, intensifying substitute pressure on DoorDash's core delivery offering.

details.pestel_factor: Technological - Ecosystem bundling and super-app dynamics
details.commentary: Amazon leveraged its technology platform and subscription ecosystem to fold food delivery into a broader digital bundle. That ecosystem approach made it easier to shift user behavior at scale, prompting investors to reassess DoorDash's ability to defend share against a tech giant.

The announcement immediately reset expectations that more restaurant orders could migrate onto Amazon's rails, hurting DoorDash's growth story. As the share price dropped, concerns about future order volumes and pricing power deepened, reinforcing the market's negative reaction on the day.
